messages:
claire: Doing a quick pass on the Hello-world quickstart for a workshop next week and noticed a few small things that will confuse beginners: the auth examples use mixed env var names, the Docker quickstart exposes port 80 (we standardize on 8080), and the 'deploy' link points to a removed path. starting a thread to batch fixes so we can ship a single docs patch.

ben: can you paste the exact snippets you hit? i'll grab the Docker + link fixes.

claire: Docker snippet currently:```yaml
services:
  app:
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_KEY=${REDWOOD_KEY}
    ports:
      - "80:80"
```
and a curl example that doesn't include auth header:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hi"}'
```
we should show the Authorization header and RW_API_KEY, and recommend 8080 for local runs.

harpreet: i'll take the curl and inline examples. proposed curl:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/create \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}'
```
add a one-line tip: "Store RW_API_KEY in your environment or secrets manager."

yang: i'll sweep the repo for REDWOOD_KEY/OLD_KEY and fix occurrences, plus update the broken deploy link to /quickstart/deploy. will open a single PR.

docs-bot: created issue #612: "quickstart: auth env unify, curl header, docker port" assigned to yang/ben/harpreet.

ben: PR #3580 opened: replace Docker port mapping to 8080 where applicable and update compose env var to RW_API_KEY. also updated starter-app example README to point to github.com/redwood-inference/starter-apps.

harpreet: PR #3581 opened: curl + examples updated to chat.create shape and migration note added at the top: "Upgrading from older examples: REDWOOD_KEY -> RW_API_KEY, generate() -> chat.create()". kept the callout compact.

yi: typo in PR title, should be yang not yi. (noted)

ci-bot: PR #3580 markdown-lint ok; link-check found one remaining absolute docs URL in legacy/docs/README.md. yang please sweep that.

yang: fixed remaining absolute URL in #3580. pushed.

harpreet: small copy nit: change "Store RW_API_KEY in your environment" to "Store RW_API_KEY in environment variables or a secret manager" — pushed to #3581.

ci-bot: PR #3581 build passed. PR #3580 build passed. both ready to merge.

ben: merging both now. after merge i'll trigger a docs site refresh so the deploy link stops 404ing.

docs-bot: PR #3580 merged by ben. PR #3581 merged by harpreet. deploy job queued.

ci-bot: docs deploy completed successfully. staging: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart (staging).

claire: verified staging: curl shows Authorization header, Docker examples reference 8080 and RW_API_KEY, and deploy link resolves. great quick turnaround — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
